Thunderstorm Advisory No. 23 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:58 PM 24 October 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(Badiangan, Janiuay, Lambunao), #Capiz(Tapaz, SapiAn, Ivisan, Sigma, Dao, Panitan, MaAyon, Pontevedra), #Aklan(Altavas, Batan), #NegrosOccidental(Pulupandan, Valladolid and BagoCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Jamindan and Mambusao) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 22 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:41 PM 24 October 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NegrosOriental(CanlaonCity), #Cebu(Barili, CityOfCarcar, Aloguinsan, Badian, Dalaguete, Alegria, Alcoy), #Bohol(Calape, SanIsidro, Catigbian, Batuan, Bilar, Lila, Dimiao, Tubigon, Buenavista, Danao, Dagohoy, Pilar, Guindulman, Anda), #NegrosOccidental(CityOfVictorias, SilayCity, EnriqueB.Magalona and SagayCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NegrosOccidental(SanCarlosCity, SalvadorBenedicto, Calatrava, Toboso, CityOfEscalante, CadizCity, Manapla), #NegrosOriental(Vallehermoso), #Cebu(Sibonga, LapuLapuCity, Cordova, MandaueCity, Consolacion, Liloan, CebuCity, Compostela, DanaoCity, Asturias, Carmen, Tuburan, Catmon, Sogod, Tabuelan, Borbon, SanRemigio, Tabogon, CityOfBogo, Daanbantayan, Medellin, Madridejos, SantaFe, Bantayan, Argao, Moalboal, Ronda, Alcantara, Dumanjug), #Bohol(Loon, Antequera, Maribojoc, Cortes, Corella, Sikatuna, Balilihan, Loboc, Loay, Sevilla, Baclayon, Alburquerque, TagbilaranCity, Dauis, Panglao, Getafe, Talibon, BienUnido, Trinidad, Ubay, SanMiguel, Alicia, Candijay, Mabini), #Iloilo(Concepcion, Batad, Estancia, Balasan, Carles, Ajuy, Sara, SanDionisio), #Capiz(PresidentRoxas and Pilar) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
